title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AD-IQ4_XS — AtomicChat on an M5 Max 64GB Mac
slug_note: An 85GB build that exceeds 64GB of RAM by keeping a 39GB n-gram PLE table pageable, at 36 tok/s with vision.

variation.quant_detail: AD-3.84bpw-IQ4_XS-M64: a 45.8GB file plus a 39.1GB pageable n-gram PLE table (84.9GB total)

engine.config: llama.cpp on Apple Silicon (Metal), with the n-gram PLE table left pageable so the build exceeds physical RAM.

requirements.notes: Vendor reports 44,125 MiB model-self (MTL0) with a 57,344 MiB wired limit, plus ~37,279 MiB host for the pageable PLE table — i.e. the file set is larger than 64GB by design and pages from disk.

steps.text: Download the AD-3.84bpw-IQ4_XS-M64 build and its n-gram PLE table
Serve with llama.cpp on Metal, keeping the PLE table pageable
Add the mmproj file if vision is needed

measurements.context: tg128, with vision, on the 85GB AD build that exceeds machine RAM via the pageable PLE table
MTL0 model-self 44,125 MiB (wired limit 57,344 MiB); host adds 37,279 MiB for the pageable table

caveats: Vendor-run and vendor-published; not independently reproduced.
The 85GB file set exceeds 64GB of RAM — it works only because the PLE table is pageable. Expect disk-bound first-token latency.

sources.note: the AD build and its measured speed/memory table
